question: Should OpenClaw define one canonical memory architecture/config contract that reconciles Markdown daily memory, builtin SQLite retrieval/indexing, QMD backend, plugin-slot ownership, and memory-flush writes, and should the open role-slot PR plus Memory MVP issues be the implementation path?
rationale: The request touches durable public config, plugin-slot API, storage defaults, QMD/builtin behavior, doctor migration semantics, and several open overlapping memory items, so automation should not choose the product direction.

options.title: Coordinate role slots plus Memory MVP
options.body: Use #60572/#88504 for memory role slots while coordinating #42646, #42651, and #42877 for canonical storage, operator commands, and write guardrails.

options.title: Narrow to one recommended default
options.body: Choose one default memory path in memory-core and route alternatives to plugins, then document and migrate existing configs accordingly.

options.title: Keep split knobs intentionally
options.body: Leave backend, search, flush, and slot controls separate, but improve doctor/status/docs so users can see and repair the active memory behavior.

recommendation.title: Coordinate role slots plus Memory MVP
recommendation.body: Use #60572/#88504 for memory role slots while coordinating #42646, #42651, and #42877 for canonical storage, operator commands, and write guardrails.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is public product/config/API direction, and CONTRIBUTING.md identifies steipete as the project decision owner.
